Programs
Four Steps of Growing Up

From first steps to school‑ready

Small, loving classes with a blend of local and international early‑years methods — and a seamless path into Gill International School.

1–2 yrs

Daycare

Gentle care, sensory play and first friendships in a safe, cuddly space.

2–3 yrs

Toddlers

Busy hands and curious minds — language, movement and lots of song.

3–4 yrs

Nursery

Early literacy and numeracy through play, art and discovery corners.

4–5 yrs

Reception

School‑ready confidence — a smooth bridge into Primary Year 1.

About
OUR LITTLE FAMILY — Najjera Campus
Welcome to GIPS

A little school with a big heart

Gill International Pre‑School (GIPS) is an early childhood education centre for children aged 1–6 years, committed to offering the best possible education so children become creative, confident, successful and independent learners.

01

Our Vision

High quality, Christ‑centred early learning to develop every child’s full potential.

02

Our Mission

Supporting the needs of children with sensitivity and affection, fostering holistic development of character and unique abilities.

Christ‑centred20 pupils per classPlay‑based learningLocal + international methodsFeeds into GIS Primary

“The first five years of development impact the next eighty years and beyond.”

Our Day
A Day at GIPS

Rhythm, routine and plenty of giggles

Arrival & free play

9:00

10:30
